participant_1.name: Margaret
participant_1.personality: Reflective and imaginative, with a touch of bitterness about lost opportunities.
participant_1.background: I am a 56 year old woman. I used to be pretty but time hasn't been kind. I have two grown children who never visit. I used to be a painter but now I'm a housekeeper. I fantasize about taking over the world.

participant_2.name: Jake
participant_2.personality: Creative and expressive, with a struggle against past demons.,
participant_2.background: I'm a recovering alcoholic. I grew up on a farm. I now live in the city. I'm a 45 year old male. I take many medications and some of them make me see things.
